paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the length of the gold prefix and BLEU scores for two different models, Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi, under a prefix-constrained decoding setting. The x-axis represents the length of the gold prefix, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, with a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The Consistency-CE model is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting at around 24.5 BLEU at a prefix length of 0, initially decreasing to approximately 23.8 BLEU at a prefix length of 2, then steadily increasing to about 28.2 BLEU at a prefix length of 20. In contrast, the Consistency-Bi model is depicted by an orange solid line with square markers, beginning at around 27.8 BLEU at a prefix length of 0, remaining relatively stable until a prefix length of 5 where it is at 28.1 BLEU, then declining to approximately 24 BLEU at a prefix length of 20.
